plugins.name: computer
plugins.description: A Linux computer for each bot, and one each chat room's bots share: a desktop you watch and take over, a terminal, a browser, and files.
plugins.note: Sets up a computer engine on this machine, then restarts fxbot.

plugins.name: chat-rooms
plugins.description: Rooms where several of your bots talk with you: tag a bot with @, bots hand work to each other, and each room keeps memories of its own and starts over from a summary.

plugins.name: dreams
plugins.description: Each night, a bot goes over its day and keeps what it learned as memories and skills, with Undo.

plugins.name: routines
plugins.description: Bots run saved tasks on a schedule, such as a morning summary, and tell you in their chat.

plugins.name: messages
plugins.description: Your bots message each other in their own chats, and you watch them work together.

plugins.name: subagents
plugins.description: Bots hand work to subagents that run in the background, and report back together. The bot's panel lists them, each with its thread.

plugins.name: soul
plugins.description: Each bot writes a short soul, who it is and how it helps you, in a first meeting with you, and keeps it up when you ask. Brings one in from Hermes Agent or OpenClaw.

plugins.name: permissions
plugins.description: Decide what each bot can do on its own: ask, a reviewer model, or run everything.

plugins.name: pages
plugins.description: Bots write reports, guides, and plans to read outside the chat, kept in the library with every version.

plugins.name: mermaid
plugins.description: Mermaid code blocks in your bots' replies and pages draw as diagrams, in the app's own colors and font, light and dark.

plugins.name: web-pairing
plugins.description: Your fxbot from your phone or any computer, at web.fxbot.sh, over a connection straight to it, paired once.
plugins.note: Connects to fxbot.sh's relay only once you pair a device, and finds the way through with Cloudflare's STUN.
